# ADR-0003: Use huggingface pipeline

> **Status:** accepted | **Date:** 2026-01-28

## Context

We want to use a model hosted at HuggingFace, and we want a way to use that model.

## Decision

We decided to use HuggingFace pipeline as it is easy to start with.

## Consequences

Positive: Easy to use.
Negative: Gives less control over the model usage.

## Alternatives Considered

- [x] Use HuggingFace pipeline
- [ ] Use PyTorch directly
